title: a constituent country is a place of its own
line: a string that ends in Scotland, England, Wales or Northern Ireland is in the United Kingdom and keeps the constituent country as its first-level unit, asked and verified like any other part: ", Scotland" is Scotland, not the United Kingdom alone, and Aberdeen lies in Scotland

steps.say: two of the owner's strings, as the export writes them
the resolver run with the geocoder's real answers planted in its cache

expect.why: the string's Scotland, a unit of its own within the United Kingdom, asked and verified, never the United Kingdom alone
Aberdeen verified as lying in Scotland, the part the string gives
